S.O. 1000 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of the India in the Ministry of Petroleum and 
Natural Gas vide Original S.O. No. 3899 ( E ) Dated 28 October 2020 and Erratum S.O. No. 1238 ( E ) Dated 15 March 
2022 published in the Gazette of the India Gazette No. 3438 dated 29 October 2020 and Gazette No. 1197 dated 21 
March 2022 Respectively and under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3 of the Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines ( Acquisition 
of Right of User in Land ) Act , 1962 ( 50 of 1962 ) , ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) the Central Government 
declared its intention to acquire the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to that notification for 
the purpose of laying “ Kandla - Gorakhpur LPG Gas Pipeline Project " for the transportation of LPG Gas in tehsil 
Phulpur District Prayagraj In the state of Uttar Pradesh by IHB Limited . 


And whereas copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the public up to 29th March 2022 
and whereas Shri Rakesh Kumar Competent Authority has under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 6 of the said Act submitted 
report to the Central Government ; 


And whereas the Central Government , after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said 
land is required for laying the pipeline , has decided to acquire right of user therein ; 


Now , therefore , in exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 6 of the said Act , the 
Central Government hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline . 


And further , in exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 4 ) of section 6 of the said Act , the Central 
Government hereby directs that the right of user in the said land for laying the pipeline shall instead of vesting in the 
Central Government , vest on the date publication of the declaration in IHB Limited , free from all encumbrances . 


[ भाग II— खण्ड 3 ( ii ) ] 

IHB Limited shall be exclusively liable for any compensation in terms of Section 10 of the P & MP Act , 1962 
and no suit claim or legal proceeding would be against the Central Government on any matter relating to the pipeline .

S.O. 005(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of the India in the Ministry of Petroleum and

Land) Act, 962 (50 of 962), (hereinafter referred to as the said Act) the Central Government declared its intention to 
acquire the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to that notification for the purpose of laying 
“Kandla-Gorakhpur LPG Gas Pipeline” for the transportation of LPG in Khajni & Sahjanwa Tehsil of Gorakhpur 
District in the state of Uttar Pradesh by THB Limited. 


And whereas copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the public up to 29" August 2022 
and whereas Shri Gyan Prakash Srivastav, Competent Authority has under sub-section (|) of section 6 of the said Act 
submitted report to the Central Government; 


And whereas the Central Government, after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said land 
is required for laying the pipeline, has decided to acquire right of user therein; 


Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section () of section 6 of the said Act, the Central 
Government hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this notification is 
hereby acquired for laying the pipeline. 


And further, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (4) of section 6 of the said Act, the Central 
Government hereby directs that the right of user in the said land for laying the pipeline shall instead of vesting in the 
Central Government, vest on the date of publication of the declaration in IHB Limited, free from all encumbrances. 


THB Limited shall be exclusively liable for any compensation in terms of Section 0 of the P&MP Act, 962 
and no suit claim or legal proceeding would be against the Central Government on any matter relating to the pipeline.

पाइपलाइन (जे एच बी डी पी एल) और Ge पाइपलाइन के माध्यम से प्राकृतिक गैस के परिवहन के लिए पाइप लाइन

MINISTRY OF PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 27th February, 2023 


S.O. 1018(E).— Whereas by the notification of Government of India in Ministry of Petroleum and Natural 
Gas vide S. O. No. 4505(E) Dated 23.09.2022, S. O. No. 4507(E) Dated 23.09.2022 and S. O. No. 4643(E) Dated 
30.09.2022 respectively issued under sub- section (1) of section 3 of the Petroleum and Minerals Pipeline (Acquisition 
of Right of Users in Land ) Act, 1962 (50 of 1962) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), Government of India 
declared its intention to acquire the Right of User in the land specified in the Schedule appended to that notification 
for the purpose of laying pipeline for transportation of natural gas through Jagdishpur — Haldia — Bokaro - Dhamra 
Pipeline (SHBDPL) & Spur Pipeline in the State of West Bengal by GAIL (India) Limited; 


And whereas copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the public; 


And, whereas the Competent Authority has, under sub-section (1) of Section 6 of the said Act, submitted his 
report to Government of India; 


And whereas Government of India after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said land is 
required for laying the pipelines, has decided to acquire the Right of User therein; 


Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 6 of the said Act, 
Government of India hereby declares that the Right of User in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline; 


And, further, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (4) of Section 6 of the said Act, Government 
of India hereby directs that the Right of User in the land for laying the pipeline shall, instead of vesting in Government 
of India, vest, on this date of the publication of the declaration, in the GAIL (India) Limited, free from all 
encumbrances.

का.आ. 1009 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने पेट्रोलियम और खनिज पाइपलाइन्स ( भूमि में उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन ) 
अधिनियम , 1962 ( 1962 का 50 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया हैं ) की धारा 3 उप धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन 
जारी की गई , भारत सरकार के पेट्रोलियम और प्राकृतिक गैस मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना जिसका प्रकाषन भारत के राजपत्र संख्या 
4589 दिनांक 07 अक्टूबर 2022 , का.आ. 4799 ( अ ) दिनांक 06 अक्टूबर 2022 भाग II खण्ड 3 उपखण्ड ( II ) में किया गया हैं , 
इस अधिसूचना से संलग्न अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य की तहसील - झाँसी , जिला- झाँसी की भूमि में उत्तर प्रदेश 
राज्य में कांडला ( गुजरात ) से गोरखपुर ( यूपी ) तक एलपीजी परिवहन के लिए आई . एच . बी लिमिटेड द्वारा क्रियान्वित किए जा 
रहें " कांडला ( गुजरात ) से गोरखपुर ( यूपी ) परियोजना ' के सम्बन्ध में पाइपलाइन बिछाने के प्रयोजन के लिए उपयोग के 
अधिकार का अर्जन करने के लिए अपने आशय की घोषणा की थीं । 


और उक्त राजपत्र अधिसूचनाओं की प्रतियां जनता को तारीख 15 अक्टूबर 2022 तक उपलब्ध करा दी गई थी । 
और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण मे श्री मदन चन्द्र दुबे सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आई ० एच ० बी ० 
लिमिटेड , काण्डला- गोरखपुर एल ० पी ० जी ० पाइपलाइन परियोजना , झाँसी ( उ ० प्र ० ) ने केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है । 


और केन्द्रीय सरकार ने उक्त रिपोर्ट पर विचार करने के पश्चात और यह समाधान हो जाने पर कि उक्त भूमि 
पाइपलाईन बिछाने के लिए अपेक्षित हैं , उसमें उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने का विनिश्चय किया है । 


( 1 ) 


[ PART II— SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए एतद् 
द्वारा घोषणा करती है कि इस अधिसूचना से संलग्न अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि में पाईपलाईन बिछाने के उपयोग का अधिकार 
अर्जित किया जाए । 


2 


और केन्द्रीय सरकार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उपधारा ( 4 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह 
निर्देश देती है कि उक्त भूमि में उपयोग का अधिकार इस घोषणा के प्रकाशन की तारीख से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित होने के 
बजाय सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आईएचबी लिमिटेड में निहित होगा । 


पेट्रोलियम और खनिज पाइपलाइन अधिनियम , 1962 की धारा 10 के अधीन किसी भी क्षतिपूर्ति के लिए आई . एच . बी 
लिमिटेड पूर्णतया उत्तरदायी होगी और पाइपलाईन से सम्बन्धित किसी भी मामलें पर केन्द्रीय सरकार के विरूद्ध कोई वादए 
दावा या कानूनी कार्यवाही नही हो सकेगी ।

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 28th February , 2023 

S.O. 1009 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of The Government of India in the Ministry of Petroleum and 
Natural Gas , Published in the Gazette No 4589 dated 07.10.2022 , S.O. No. 4799 ( E ) dated 06.10.2022 Part - II , Section 
3 , Sub - Section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3 of the Petroleum and minerals pipelines ( Acquisition of 
Right of User in Land ) Act , 1962 ( 50 of 1962 ) , ( Hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government 
declared its intention to acquire the right of user in the land situated in Tehsil- Jhansi , District- Jhansi in Uttar Pradesh 
State , specified in the schedule appended to that notification for the purpose of laying pipeline for the transportation of 
LPG from Kandla to Gorakhpur by the IHB Ltd for implementing the Kandla to Gorakhpur LPG Pipeline Project . 

And whereas the copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the public on 15 October 


And whereas Shri Madan Chandra Dubey , Competent Authority , IHB Limited , Kandla Gorakhpur LPG 
Pipeline Project , Jhansi ( UP ) has under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 6 of the said Act , has submitted his report to Central 

Government . 


And whereas , the Central Government after Considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said 
land is required for laying the pipeline , has decided to acquire right of the user therein ; 


Now , therefore , in exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 6 of the said Act , the 
Central Government hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline ; 


[ भाग II— खण्ड 3 ( ii ) ] 

3 

And further , in exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 4 ) of section 6 of the said Act , the Central 
Government hereby directs that the right of user of the said land for laying the pipeline shall , instead of vesting in the 
Central Government , vests on the date of publication of this declaration , in IHB Ltd , free from all encumbrances . 


IHB Ltd shall be exclusively liable for any compensation in terms of section 10 of the P & MP Act , 1962 
and no suit , claim or legal proceeding would lie against the Central Government on any matter relating to pipeline .

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 28th February , 2023 

S.O. 999 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of the India in the Ministry of Petroleum and 
Natural Gas vide Original S.O. No. 3338 ( E ) dated 24 Sept. 2020 and Erratum S.O. No. 1237 ( E ) Dated 15 March 
2022 published in the Gazette of the India Gazette No. 2982 dated 26 Sept. 2020 and Gazette No 1196 dated 21 
March 2022 Respectively and under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3 of the Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines ( Acquisition 
of Right of User in Land ) Act , 1962 ( 50 of 1962 ) , ( here in after referred to as the said Act ) the Central Government 
declared its intention to acquire the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to that notification for 
the purpose of laying “ Kandla - Gorakhpur LPG Gas Pipeline Project " for the transportation of LPG Gas in tehsil 
Soraon , District - Prayagraj in the state of Uttar Pradesh by IHB Limited . 


And whereas copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the public up to 31 March 2022 
and whereas the Shri Rakesh Kumar Competent Authority has under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 6 of the said Act 
submitted report to the Central Government ; 


And whereas the Central Government , after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said 
land is required for laying the pipeline , has decided to acquire right of user therein ; 


Now , therefore , in exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 6 of the said Act , the 
Central Government hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline . 


[ भाग II— खण्ड 3 ( ii ) ] 

3 

And further , in exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 4 ) of section 6 of the said Act , the Central 
Government hereby directs that the right of user in the said land for laying the pipeline shall instead of vesting in the 
Central Government , vest on the date publication of the declaration in IHB Limited , free from all encumbrances . 


IHB Limited shall be exclusively liable for any compensation in terms of Section 10 of the P & MP Act , 1962 
and no suit claim or legal proceeding would be against the Central Government on any matter relating to the pipeline .

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 27th February , 2023 

S.O. 1020 ( E ) .— Whereas , it appears to Government that it is necessary in the public interest that for 
transportation of Natural Gas through Mumbai - Nagpur - Jharsuguda Natural Gas Pipeline Section of Nagpur to 
Jabalpur in the State of Madhya Pradesh , a pipeline should be laid by M / s GAIL ( India ) Limited . 

And , whereas , it appears to Government of India that for the purpose of laying the said pipeline , it is 
necessary to acquire the Right of user in land under which the said pipeline is proposed to be laid , and which is 
described in the Schedule annexed to this notification ; 


Chhindwara 


Now , therefore , in exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3 of the Petroleum and 
Minerals Pipelines ( Acquisition of Right of User in Land ) Act , 1962 ( 50 of 1962 ) , Government of India hereby 
declares its intention to acquire the right of user therein ; 


Chhindwara 


Any person interested in the land described in the said schedule , may within twenty one days from the date 
on which the copies of this notification issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of Section 3 of the said Act , as published in the 
Gazette of India , are made available to the General Public , Object in writing to the acquisition of the right of user 
therein or laying of the pipeline under the land to the Competent Authority , M / s GAIL ( India ) Limited state of 
Madhya Pradesh .

नई दिल्ली , 28 फरवरी , 2023 

का.आ. 1002 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने पेट्रोलियम और खनिज पाइपलाइन्स ( भूमि में उपयोग के अधिकार का 
अर्जन ) अधिनियम 1962 ( 1962 का 50 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 उप - धारा 
( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई , भारत सरकार के पेट्रोलियम और प्राकृतिक गैस मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना जिसका प्रकाशन 
भारत के राजपत्र संख्या 3080 दिनांक 20 जुलाई 2022 का.आ. 3240 ( अ ) दिनांक 15 जुलाई 2022 भाग || खण्ड 3 
उपखण्ड ( II ) में किया गया है , इस अधिसूचना से संलग्न अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य की तहसील - कानपुर सदर , 
जिला - कानपुर नगर की भूमि में उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य में काण्डला ( गुजरात ) से गोरखपुर ( यूपी ) तक एलपीजी परिवहन के लिए 
आई . एच . बी लिमिटेड द्वारा क्रियान्वित किए जा रहें " काण्डला ( गुजरात ) से गोरखपुर ( यूपी ) परियोजना " के सम्बन्ध में 
पाइपलाइन बिछाने के प्रयोजन के लिए उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने के लिए अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी । 


और उक्त राजपत्र अधिसूचनाओं की प्रतियाँ जनता को तारीख 06 अगस्त 2022 तक उपलब्ध करा दी गई थी । 
और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में श्री सोमदत्त मौर्य , सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आईएचबी 
लिमिटेड , काण्डला गोरखपुर एलपीजी पाइपलाइन , कानपुर ( यू 0 पी 0 ) ने केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है । 


और केन्द्रीय सरकार ने उक्त रिपोर्ट पर विचार करने के पश्चात और यह समाधान हो जाने पर कि उक्त भूमि 
पाइपलाइन बिछाने के लिए अपेक्षित है , उसमें उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने का विनिश्चय किया है । 


( 1 ) 


[ PART II— SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए 
एतद् द्वारा घोषणा करती है कि इस अधिसूचना से संलग्न अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि में पाइपलाइन बिछाने के उपयोग का 
अधिकार अर्जित किया जाए । 


2 


और केन्द्रीय सरकार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उपधारा ( 4 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह 
निर्देश देती है कि उक्त भूमि में उपयोग का अधिकार इस घोषणा के प्रकाशन की तारीख से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित होने के 
बजाय सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आईएचबी लिमिटेड में निहित होगा । 


पेट्रोलियम और खनिज पाइपलाइन अधिनियम , 1962 की धारा 10 के अधीन किसी भी क्षतिपूर्ति के लिए 
आई.एच.बी लिमिटेड पूर्णतया उत्तरदायी होगी और पाइपलाइन से सम्बन्धित किसी भी मामले पर केन्द्रीय सरकार के 
विरूद्ध कोई वाद , दावा या कानूनी कार्यवाही नहीं हो सकेगी ।

New Delhi , the 28th February , 2023 

S.O. 1002 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of The Government of India in the Ministry of Petroleum and 
Natural Gas , published in the Gazette No. 3080 dated 20.07.2022 , S.O. No. 3240 ( E ) dated 15.07.2022 Part - II , 
Section - 3 , Sub - Section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3 of the Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines 
( Acquisition of Right of User in Land ) Act , 1962 ( 50 of 1962 ) , ( Hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central 
Government declared its intention to acquire the right of user in the land situated in Tehsil Kanpur Sadar , District 
Kanpur Nagar in Uttar Pradesh State , specified in the schedule appended to that notification for the purpose of laying 
pipeline for the transportation of LPG from Kandla to Gorakhpur by the IHB Ltd. for implementing the Kandla to 
Gorakhpur LPG Pipeline Project . 

And whereas the copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the public on 06 August 


And whereas Shri Somdatt Maurya , Competent Authority , IHB Limited , Kandla Gorakhpur LPG Pipeline 
Project , Kanpur ( UP ) has under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 6 of the said Act , has submitted his report to Central 
Government .

land is required for laying the pipeline , has decided to acquire right of the user therein ; 


Now , therefore , in exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 6 of the said Act , the 
Central Government hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline ;

एच बी लिमिटेड , काण्डला गोरखपुर एल पी जी पाइपलाइन , कानपुर ( यूपी ) ने केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी

पाइपलाइन ( जे एच बी डी पी एल ) और स्पर पाइपलाइन के माध्यम से प्राकृतिक गैस के परिवहन के लिए पाइप लाइन बिछाने के

और उक्त राजपत्रित अधिसूचना की प्रतियां जनता को उपलब्ध करा दी गई थी ; 

और , सक्षम प्राधिकार ने , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन भारत सरकार को अपनी रिपोर्ट दे 

दी है ; 


और भारत सरकार ने , उक्त रिपोर्ट पर विचार करने के पश्चात और यह संतुष्ट हो जाने पर कि उक्त भूमि पाइपलाइनें 
बिछाने के लिए अपेक्षित है , उस में उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने का विनिश्चय किया है ; 


अतः अब , भारत सरकार , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उप - धारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुये , 
यह घोषणा करती है कि इस अधिसूचना से संलग्न अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि में पाइपलाइनें बिछाने के लिए उपयोग के

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 27th February , 2023 

S.O. 1017 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of Government of India in Ministry of Petroleum and Natural 
Gas published vide S.O No : 4100 ( E ) Dated 01.09.2022 issued under sub- section ( 1 ) of section 3 of the Petroleum 
and Minerals Pipeline ( Acquisition of Right of Users in Land ) Act , 1962 ( 50 of 1962 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the 
said Act ) , Government of India declared its intention to acquire the Right of User in the land specified in the Schedule 
appended to that notification for the purpose of laying pipeline for transportation of natural gas through Jagdishpur – 
Haldia - Bokaro – Dhamra Pipeline ( JHBDPL ) & Spur Pipeline in the State of West Bengal by GAIL ( India ) 
Limited ; 


MINISTRY OF PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS 


And whereas copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the public ; 

And , whereas the Competent Authority has , under sub - section ( 1 ) of Section 6 of the said Act , submitted his 
report to Government of India ; 


And whereas Government of India after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said land is 
required for laying the pipelines , has decided to acquire the Right of User therein ; 


Now , therefore , in exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 6 of the said Act , 
Government of India hereby declares that the Right of User in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline ; 


District 


And , further , in exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 4 ) of Section 6 of the said Act , Government 
of India hereby directs that the Right of User in the land for laying the pipeline shall , instead of vesting in Government 
of India , vest , on this date of the publication of the declaration , in the GAIL ( India ) Limited , free from all 
encumbrances .

983.119 acres for all rights] ( approximately) only mining rights and all rights in or over the said land as described in

are hereby acquired;

New Delhi, the 3rd March, 2023 


S.O. 1044(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (46) of section 10 of the Income-tax Act, 1961 
(43 of 1961), the Central Government hereby notifies for the purposes of the said clause, Karnataka State Building and 
Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (PAN AAALK0820C), a Board constituted by the State Government of 
Karnataka, in respect of the following specified income arising to that Board, namely:- 


(a) Cess collected on construction cost levied u/s 3(1) of the Building and Other Construction Workers’ 
Cess Act, 1996; 


(b) Registration fee & annual subscriptions received from the establishments; and 


(c) Interest earned on (a) & (b) above. 


2; This notification shall be effective subject to the conditions that Karnataka State Building and Other 
Construction Workers Welfare Board,- 
(a) shall not engage in any commercial activity; 
(b) activities and the nature of the specified income shall remain unchanged throughout the financial 
years; and 
(c) shall file return of income in accordance with the provision of clause (g) of sub-section (4C) of 


section 139 of the Income-tax Act, 1961. 


3. This notification shall be deemed to have been applied for the financial year 2020-2021 (for period from 01- 
06-2020 to 31-03-2021) and for the financial year 2021-2022 and shall be applicable with respect to the financial 
years 2022-2023, 2023-2024 and 2024-2025. 


[Notification No. 12/2023/F.No.300196/61/2018-ITA-I] 
SOURABH JAIN, Under Secy. 


Explanatory Memorandum 


It is certified that no person is being adversely affected by giving retrospective effect to this notification.
